page: Vultr vbm-72c-480gb-gh200-gpu is a bare metal server configured with the NVIDIA Grace Hopper Superchip architecture. The system features 72 dedicated physical cores based on the arm64 Neoverse V2 CPU architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz with one thread per core. It is equipped with 480.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.67 GB of RAM per core.

The server integrates a single NVIDIA Hopper GH200 GPU featuring 96 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. Local storage is provided by a 960 GB NVMe SSD, and the configuration includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. This unified memory architecture allows high-speed data transfer between the Grace CPU and Hopper GPU.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this bare metal instance offers high resource density by combining a high-core arm64 CPU with a specialized Hopper GPU on a single module. This design reduces latency and power consumption compared to traditional PCIe-based GPU configurations. The server is designed for workloads such as large language model inference, deep learning training, data science pipelines, and high-performance computing tasks that require massive VRAM and dedicated physical cores.
